chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from Ibn Muskan, from Zurarah, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

Do you know why the cubit and the two cubits were established? I said: Why? He said: “Because of the obligatory prayer; you may perform supererogatory prayer from the sun’s decline until it reaches one cubit. Then when it reaches one cubit, you begin with the obligatory prayer and leave the supererogatory prayer.”

key_terms.الذِّرَاعَانِ: two cubits; an extended measure related to prayer timing
key_terms.الذِّرَاعُ: a cubit; a measure used here to determine a prayer-time boundary
key_terms.زَوَالِ: the sun’s decline from the meridian

ai.seo_question: Why were the measures of one cubit and two cubits established in relation to prayer times?
ai.summary: This hadith explains a legal measure used to mark the time distinction between supererogatory and obligatory prayer after the sun’s decline. It indicates that nafilah may be performed until a specified point, after which one begins the obligatory prayer.
